title: Fee Schedule Note: Fee Standing on a Charged Cleaning Fee at a Lower Level (Cleaning and Damage Fees)
content:
**Rule.** When a charged Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee, undisputed, disputed or upheld, is held at a cleaning level whose entry gate does not list the incident category reported, it is moved down to the highest lower cleaning level whose entry gate lists that category; the fee carried to the level moved to is that level's flat fee, and the fee standing at the level moved to is the fee carried to it, rounded half up to the cent.

## Figures

| Cleaning level | Incident categories its entry gate lists | Flat fee |
|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | food or drink spill; trash or debris; animal hair or mess | $25.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | food or drink spill; trash or debris; smoke or vape odor; animal hair or mess | $60.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | food or drink spill; smoke or vape odor; animal hair or mess; bodily fluids | $100.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | bodily fluids | $150.00 |

## Level moved from, level moved to and fee standing

| Level moved from (the level held) | Incident category reported | Level moved to | Fee standing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | food or drink spill, smoke or vape odor, or animal hair or mess | Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $100.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | trash or debris | Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $60.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | trash or debris | Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $60.00 |

The level moved from is the level the assessment holds before the move; the level moved to is the highest cleaning level below it whose entry gate lists the category.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

An assessment charged and upheld at Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) records smoke or vape odor. Level 4's entry gate lists bodily fluids only; the highest lower level listing smoke or vape odor is Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant). The fee standing at that level is its flat fee, $100.00.
